main_text.head: DE RATIONE CONTEXENDARVM EPISTOLARVM
Pars II.

head.i: Demonstratiui generis: & quidem primò Gratulatorias Epistolas continens.

main_text.p: Demonstra-tiui generis Epistolæ.ABsolutis Deliberatiui generis Epistolis, reliquum est, de iis vt agatur, quæ ad Demonstratiuum referendæ esse videntur: quales sunt laudatoriæ, reprehensoriæ, gratiarum continentes actiones, dedicatoriæ, gratulatoriæ, à quibus initium nunc faciemus, propterea quòd præ cæteris vsurpari crebrò illæ solent. Sunt autem gratulatoriæ συγχαρητικαὶ [?] Gratulato-rię Epistolę.Epistolæ, in quibus amico de rerum fuc-cessu prospero, & ad voluntatem fluente

page.notes: The woodcut initial is the letter A, joined to "Absolutis" as "ABsolutis". The Greek word "συγχαρητικαὶ" is uncertain and marked [?]. The printed hyphen in "fuc-cessu" is kept at the line end. The long s is plain s throughout. The margin notes are in italic type. The printed page number is 129.
